nodes.name: RuO2 catalyst ink preparation
nodes.procedure: First, 10 mg RuO2 and 2 mg C65 carbon black were added to 1 ml deionized water containing 50 μl Nafion solution (5 wt%). The mixture was sonicated for 30 min to obtain a well-dispersed catalyst ink.

nodes.name: Ni(OH)2 electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: The Ni(OH)2 electrocatalysts used for ammonia oxidation were prepared through an established electrodeposition technique in which nitrate is reduced at the working electrode, leading to an increase in the local pH that causes Ni2+ to precipitate out as Ni(OH)2. The electrodeposition was achieved by maintaining a -0.25 mA cm-2 current density for 45 s with a deposition solution consisting of 10 mM Ni(NO3)2·6H2O and 30 mM KNO3.

nodes.description: HER LSVs in unbuffered, unstirred solutions pH 0,1,7,12 H2 saturated
nodes.source_text: When we experimentally obtain LSVs with a platinum working electrode (WE) in unbuffered and unstirred solutions saturated with H2 at pH 0, 1, 7 and 12 (Fig. 1b)... At pH 1 two reduction features are observed. The onset of the first feature (marked as 1) occurs at around -0.059 V_SHE... second reduction feature (marked as 2) appears at around -0.8 V_SHE. At pH 7 appreciable reduction current does not appear until around -0.7 V_SHE, which is considerably more negative than the expected onset potential (-0.413 V_SHE).
